title: Item:Crafting Experience Elixir
wikitext:
__NOTOC__{{Top}} Drinking a '''Crafting Experience Elixir''' grants your character [[Cannith Crafting level progression|crafting experience]] bonus. This increases your crafting experience. The effect lasts for the next 30 minutes that you are logged in. The effect timer does NOT pause. Drinking multiple Crafting Experience Elixirs stack the duration, and if multiple sizes of '''Crafting Experience Elixir'''s are consumed, the highest (largest) size will be used first, while the remaining sizes will be paused. Crafting Experience Elixirs affect all crafting experience gained during their duration.
